digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — Pass-2 verify / Pass-3 decide
propositions: The judge's per-finding decision (block/advisory/dropped/indeterminate from pass3_decide) drifts across repeated runs, injecting noise into the R5 sub-answer vocabulary; E6 measures self-consistency via 3-vote Fleiss' κ and raw agreement over 50 G6/E4/T3 cohort findings.

Section-order permutation of the input plan flips the gate verdict (PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE) in a non-negligible fraction of cases, threatening order-exposed criteria; E6 measures residual order-sensitivity via 3-distinct-permutation shuffle over 14 plan-text samples.
Infra failures (llm_unavailable, verify_failed) mask genuine judge INDETERMINATE verdicts; E6 excludes and re-runs any verdict marked with these flags, retaining only stable judge outputs.
Self-consistency passes if Fleiss' κ≥0.6 AND raw agreement≥0.8; a pass gates R5 advancement, a fail blocks it.
Order-shuffle stability passes if Fleiss' κ≥0.6 AND raw agreement≥0.8; a pass permits R3 to land container criteria, a fail is an R3 prerequisite blocker.
E6 is measurement-only over the existing gate with bounded LLM spend (150 agentic Pass-2 calls for Exp A + 42 full-gate runs for Exp B); no src/rebar code changes.
